Here, the Abhidhammas in the alphabetical form of Udaharun, which are issued in alphabetical order, are the opening words of Abhivatha, 2.233. . Abhihate-hu Dantajata is found in Pratisana, Hta, 1.77, and Abhiha-te, only in Abhidha, in 2.62, is called Muddhazatha. In particular, in Abhidha, 2.233, there is Abhihate-hu Dantajata, and in that 62 book, there is Abhihate-hu Muddhazata, and it is a kind of front and back. The conversion of the Dantaja alphabet to the Muddhaza alphabet is generally performed only on the later elements of the water which are either watery or watery. Since the elements of these Abhidhammas are pure Hana-elements, there is no water, no water, and there is no reason for the later Dantajata-substance to be transferred to Muddha-jata.
